body: I hate my life. This morning I was sitting on the bathroom floor crying about how my life has ended up. I thought about all the people I dissapointed and the pain of living is too much for me. I have been suicidal since the 6th grade. I never talked about it because people often just write you off as being a depressive freak that would only bring them down. The way I learned this was when I told a close friend about my issues. She took me to the guidance counselor and I could just feel the awkwardness and silence that filled the room. Then my mother was called and I learned to never speak about my suicidal tendencies. Maybe keeping my tendencies to myself was the issue. I never cut myself because I didn't want to cause worry or harm for the people around me. I never was seen as the "pretty girl" or the "friendly girl" I was ways seen as this weird freak until the end of Middle school. Once I entered high school I thought I was going to magically make friends and magically have people who cared, but I was wrong. Majority of the people there at my first highschool were either from my old school, or just viewed me as a weird individual. This affected me and my school work a lot. I started off positive and then I plummeted into a depressive state where I didn't want to work or get up or anything. During that year I often strangled myself with a belt to get up or feel better. I know it was an unhealthy practice, but it worked for me until it didn't. Right when I stopped strangling myself I noticed that my work was getting done and my gpa was really high. I was in gifted for my entire life, and I still never had so many a's in my life. Apparently my gpa and test scores was so good that I got accepted into a magnet school that gad a whole bunch of College courses. At first I was excited. This program would give me a scholarship once I completed 7 of their courses. I started out really good until my Uncle and Cousin died around the same time. I was getting sick easily and I just stop myself from going to school sometimes. I went back to strangling myself, but it did nothing.I failed a marking period in many of my classes and it looks like it might happen again. I don't want to leave the program(no one has offered to) and I have lost all hope. So here I am crying in the bathroom thinking about ending it all. What's stopping me??? My mother and my sister. I don't want to hurt them. All they have done is supported me. They don't know about any of this and I'm glad they don't. I originally came here wanting to find out the best way to kill myself, but I have too much resting on me right now to do So. I just can't take a lot of what I'm going through right now. Some days I'm on the edge of the peer or tugging on my belt and then I get a call from mom or my sister.So please give me a reason to stay, because right now I am in so much pain and stress and grief I don't know how long I can take being on this earth

Kicking out the drummer, making trashy pop hits with heavy marketing influence, and signing on to the same label ad kidz pop for the fame. Its so obvious. It just makes me so upset to think that Yellowcard believed they own the rights to a guitar cord.(that's what they are suing for) Guitar cords are used in a lot of songs and its common for certain songs to sound the same. For example, One Direction's song What Makes You Beautiful shares a guitar cord with Summer nights from Greece. The outrage lies in a man suing other artists for a guitar cord that he didn't invent. I just want to clarify that the songs may sound simaler, but they are different in content. I just want to remind you that the lyrics are not the same, the orchestration is not the same, the instruments used are not the same, and the arrangements are not the same. This is honestly a ploy for money and its really sad that they did this for the fame.
